goal: Publish a standalone, source-bound Word paper that states a falsifiable low-competence orchestration hypothesis without promoting it to established fact

required_nodes.obligation: Human-outcome narrative differentiates novice orchestration from specialist validation
Product, software and repository stay distinct in every case
ROA/RLA/CRC/ECNN/ECU interpreted as proposals without formal proof claims
Bryophyte 20 levels/42 parameters and simulator original commit pinned
Botanist blind real-vs-synthetic study identified as not executed
AOSP explicitly identified as an ecosystem rather than a product
CORA Project prompt+ZIP novice route and authorization requirements described
120 original source/file pins split across six product studies
Cryptographic digest, authenticated issuer, semantic truth and runtime separated
Security mutation value bounded by real original negative oracles
100 scientific challenge questions and 10,000 repeatable model mutants
147 physical OOXML mutants detected and 10 benign controls preserved
Word exact SHA-256 reproduced and same Git blob embedded in PR
Independent user expertise threshold and causal comparison
Effective protected branch review and release authorization

inference_ceiling: Git hashes prove neither identity of reviewer, effectiveness of software, human labor reduction, nor biological truth

acceptance.local: exact reproducibility + finite author-defined negative controls + readable Word
acceptance.publication: needs independent scientific/domain review; cannot be self-issued
